page.title: Galactic Occupations
page.t: Operating range (0 = home sector; 99 = entire connected galaxy)
Preferred faction: select one of its ships/stations
Escort an active commercial voyage to its actual destination. Custom service contract.
Transport up to ten real NPC passengers, limited by free crew berths. Stay docked until every passenger physically boards; 8,000 Cr each after delivery.
Close component surveys with surface approaches and ten seconds of clear line of sight. Publish native per-component scan data at the player scanner cap.
Explore connections, catalogue anomalies and their actual destination lists.
Board up to ten passengers, visit ten distinct sights across the connected galaxy, then return for drop-off. Default luxury fare: 500,000 Cr per passenger.

Harvest actual asteroid crystal deposits with forward weapons or turrets on any normal ship size. Collect real drops and immediately send crystals to player inventory. Physical simulation required; no auto-sale.
Provoke a manageable hostile and retreat to a stronger friendly force. Detect pursuit and abandon failed attempts.
Shoot actual destructible asteroids. High attention required for physical firing.
Improve eligible crew morale, with ship and faction cooldowns. Reputation requires actual improvement.
Perform the timed NPC cargo-inspection equivalent under local jurisdiction. Report contraband without forcing hostility.
Attempt surrender of capturable, non-mission hostile ships below 25 percent hull; preserve hull, equipment and crew.
Follow real trader destinations, escort traffic and intercept manageable threats along its route.
